skill.name: technical-analyst
skill.description: Analyze weekly charts for stocks, indices, cryptocurrencies, and forex. Identify trends, key levels, moving-average structure, volume signals, and probability-weighted scenarios from chart data.
skill.summary: Create structured weekly technical analysis and contrarian price-action confirmation reports.
skill.author: tradermonty

security_audit.summary: No malicious intent, prompt injection, credential exfiltration, shell execution, or concealed payload was found. Most static hits are Markdown, docstrings, imports, or test fixtures. The command-line API key can expose a credential locally, and the prerequisite text understates data-mode requirements.

remediation.issue: The --api-key option can expose the FMP credential in shell history and process listings.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer FMP_API_KEY or secure standard input. Remove the option, or warn users clearly that command-line secrets may be locally visible.

remediation.issue: The prerequisite section claims that the skill needs no API key or external fetch.
remediation.suggestion: Separate chart-mode prerequisites from data-mode prerequisites, including network access, the requests package, and FMP_API_KEY.

content.user_title: Analyze Weekly Price Charts with Clear Scenarios
content.value_statement: Weekly charts can produce conflicting signals and vague forecasts. This skill structures chart evidence into trends, levels, patterns, and probability-weighted scenarios.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes user-provided weekly chart images across stocks, indices, cryptocurrencies, and forex.
Identifies trend direction, support, resistance, chart patterns, and visible volume behavior.
Assesses price relationships with 20-week, 50-week, and 200-week moving averages when shown.
Builds two to four probability-weighted scenarios with targets and invalidation levels.
Runs deterministic weekly contrarian checks using FMP price data when script mode is requested.
limitations: It excludes news, fundamentals, sentiment, and macroeconomic information from chart analysis.
Visual findings depend on chart resolution, labels, indicators, and visible price history.
Script mode requires network access, the requests package, and an FMP API key.
Outputs are analytical scenarios, not personalized investment advice or guaranteed forecasts.

use_cases.title: Review a Portfolio Chart
use_cases.description: Assess one weekly chart for trend quality, decisive levels, and balanced future scenarios.

use_cases.title: Screen Market Structure
use_cases.description: Compare separate weekly reports for several symbols while preserving consistent analysis criteria.

use_cases.title: Confirm a Contrarian Setup
use_cases.description: Test whether weekly price action confirms reversal evidence after a market becomes crowded.
use_cases.target_user: Systematic traders using a contrarian workflow

prompt_templates.title: Basic Weekly Chart Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this weekly chart for [SYMBOL]. Identify the trend, major support and resistance, and two likely scenarios. State any visible limitations.

prompt_templates.title: Structured Technical Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full weekly technical analysis for [SYMBOL] from the attached chart. Cover trend, moving averages, volume, patterns, key levels, targets, and invalidations.

prompt_templates.title: Breakout Decision Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether [SYMBOL] is preparing to break [LEVEL]. Compare breakout, rejection, and consolidation scenarios. Assign probabilities totaling 100 percent.

prompt_templates.title: Contrarian Confirmation Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess [SYMBOL] as [CROWDED_LONG or CROWDED_SHORT] through [AS_OF_DATE]. Apply weekly reversal, failed extreme, failed breakout, continuation veto, and swing-level rules.

output_examples.input: Analyze the attached weekly SPY chart.
output: Trend: Moderate uptrend with momentum weakening near resistance.
Key levels: Support near 540 and resistance near 575.
Base case: Consolidation above support, 50 percent probability.
Bull case: Weekly close above resistance, 30 percent probability.
Bear case: Breakdown below support, 20 percent probability.

output_examples.input: Check whether crowded-long Bitcoin shows weekly reversal evidence.
output: Reason: No recent reversal signal passed the continuation veto.
Stop reference: Nearest qualified weekly swing high.
Caveat: The result depends on completed weekly bars and the selected information cutoff.

output_examples.input: Compare the attached weekly EURUSD and GBPUSD charts.
output_examples.output: Two separate reports summarize each chart's trend, levels, patterns, scenario probabilities, invalidations, and visible data limitations.

best_practices: Provide a clear weekly chart with readable dates, prices, volume, and requested moving averages.
Specify the symbol, chart date, and any level or scenario requiring closer attention.
Treat probabilities as conditional estimates and review invalidation levels when new weekly bars complete.
anti_patterns: Do not request precise level analysis from cropped or unreadable charts.
Do not combine chart-only conclusions with undisclosed news or fundamental assumptions.
Do not treat a technical scenario or contrarian verdict as an automatic trade instruction.

faq.question: Which markets can this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It supports weekly charts for stocks, stock indices, cryptocurrencies, forex pairs, and mapped futures markets.

faq.question: Does chart mode require an API key?
faq.answer: No. Chart mode uses the image supplied by the user.

faq.question: When does script mode require an API key?
faq.answer: The data-driven contrarian mode requires an FMP API key to retrieve historical OHLC data.

faq.question: Does the skill include fundamental analysis?
faq.answer: No. It intentionally excludes news, earnings, valuation, sentiment, and macroeconomic factors.

faq.question: Are scenario probabilities forecasts?
faq.answer: They are conditional estimates based on visible technical evidence, not guarantees or calibrated financial forecasts.

faq.question: Can the output be used as a trade recommendation?
faq.answer: No. The output supports research and requires separate decisions for entries, exits, sizing, and risk controls.
